proofs.text: Open the board with the solo fixture, which has never recorded, and verify the heading row offers no latest record, no approvals and no risk, and that no risk-by-state grid is on screen; open it with the team fixture and verify latest record, strength, re-verify and risk are offered, approvals are not, and exactly 1 grid is on screen; open it with the regulated fixture and verify approvals are offered

reasons: PROOF-9 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A column appears only where the artifact it reports exists: risk and the risk-by-state grid where a rule is tagged above low, test strength, latest record and re-verify where a record exists, approvals where an approval exists. A project that has never recorded shows none of them

tests.body:
def test_columns_appear_only_where_their_artifacts_do(browser, tmp_path):
    """A project that has never recorded shows no record column."""
    solo = open_board(browser, tmp_path / 'solo', payload_named('solo'))
    head = solo.inner_text('.th')
    assert 'LATEST RECORD' not in head
    assert 'APPROVALS' not in head
    assert 'RISK' not in head
    assert solo.query_selector_all('table.grid') == []
    solo.close()

    team = open_board(browser, tmp_path / 'team', payload_named('team'))
    head = team.inner_text('.th')
    assert 'LATEST RECORD' in head and 'STRENGTH' in head
    assert 'RE-VERIFY' in head and 'RISK' in head
    assert 'APPROVALS' not in head
    assert len(team.query_selector_all('table.grid')) == 1
    team.close()

    reg = open_board(browser, tmp_path / 'reg', payload_named('regulated'))
    assert 'APPROVALS' in reg.inner_text('.th')
    reg.close()
